content.title: FAAB: A Benchmark for Fault Detection and Responsibility Attribution in Financial Multi-Agent Workflows
content.abstract: Financial multi-agent systems distribute evidence extraction, expectation retrieval, consistency checking, decision, and settlement across roles. When a final claim is wrong, outcome accuracy cannot say where the evidence chain first broke or which role was responsible. We formulate financial multi-agent workflow auditing : given a typed workflow trace, detect whether a fault occurred, classify its root cause, and localize the earliest responsible agent and step. We introduce the Financial Agent Audit Benchmark (FAAB) for that task, built from 300 real point-in-time SEC and I/B/E/S workflows a
